bio: You can tell that an experienced chef is at work here! Ernst Moser serves up an appealing range of sophisticated dishes, including pizza and pasta, which can be ordered as a set menu or à la carte. Diners choose from options such as vitello forello, pigeon royale, glazed belly of Alpine pork, and spaghetti Ernesto. Plus there is a well-curated wine list and friendly, attentive service. The restaurant, which adjoins a tennis centre, is not only popular with locals and regulars, so don't forget to make a reservation. You can also make the most of the small terrace....
